scope: Level 1 Night town, combat, water, fog, and flight presentation
renderer_claim: presentation quality target only; not an Exact gameplay claim

look_definition.night_readability: deep blue night values preserve near-terrain and actor silhouettes
look_definition.settlements: warm emissive settlements read as navigational anchors without clipping the frame
look_definition.silhouettes: player, enemies, castle, and terrain remain distinguishable during motion
look_definition.bloom: restrained and localized around spell/settlement emitters
look_definition.atmosphere: depth increases monotonically from near terrain through fog to a readable horizon
look_definition.spell_light: cast/impact light is event-driven and responsive without becoming a permanent exposure change
look_definition.horizon: the horizon remains legible and does not collapse into a flat wash
look_definition.art_boundary: no replacement art is needed to pass this target; concept art alone is not evidence

exact.frame_hash: sha256 of indexed FINAL MAIN bytes
exact.state_hash: required when the checkpoint provides one
exact.comparison: byte equality within the protected 320x200 profile

classic-hd.frame_hash: sha256 of indexed rerender bytes when deterministic
classic-hd.comparison: byte equality within a fixed profile; otherwise structural regions plus human review
classic-hd.forbidden_claim: a final-frame upscale is not a Classic HD pass

unity-enhanced.comparison: tolerant structural/region metrics plus human review

over-bloom.rule: emissive halos obscure required silhouettes or clipped-highlight fraction exceeds 0.5 percent of the reviewed frame

crushed-blacks.rule: near-terrain or actor silhouette region loses its required shape at review exposure

fog-washout.rule: fog makes the required horizon or near/mid/far separation unreadable

unreadable-hud.rule: required life/mana/spell/objective regions cannot be read at the target display profile

unstable-exposure.rule: identical input-only route changes exposure or settlement/spell readability without a gameplay event

temporal-ghosting.rule: history leaves a visible duplicate of the player, actor, spell, or terrain after the route changes

concept-art-only-detail.rule: a review relies on an illustration or replacement asset not produced by the measured renderer path

human_review.decision: all blocker criteria must pass; record per-region notes and build metadata
